Mechanisms of gelofusine protection in an in vitro model of polymyxin B-associated renal injury. Polymyxins are a last-resort treatment option for multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacterial infections, but they are associated with nephrotoxicity. Gelofusine was previously shown to reduce polymyxin-associated kidney injury in an animal model. However, the mechanism(s) of renal protection has not been fully elucidated. results.text: Probenecid protects against contrast-induced nephropathy through modulation of small Rho GTPases and Pannexin1 channels in Wistar rats. Contrast agents are known to increase the risk of radiocontrast-induced nephropathy (CIN), particularly in elderly, diabetic, or dehydrated patients. However, the exact molecular mechanisms leading to renal injury in CIN remain unclear.
